name: 28670 · Ronda, NC
findings: ZIP 28670 (Ronda) has 9 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28670 (Ronda) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28670 (Ronda) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
